svg.title: G · Motion through a tube: fixed barrels and measured stroke
svg.desc: Original classroom construction plan with labeled parts and finished views. Not to scale. Use written dimensions and numbered lesson steps.
svg.text: G · Motion through a tube: fixed barrels and measured stroke
Hold barrels still. Do not assist the output plunger.
Air trial first; teacher then fills syringe/tube system with water.
Use ruler start/end positions: input stroke = 20 mm.
Three trials per fluid. Reset to the same pointer marks each time.
Stop if resistance rises. Never force a blocked system.
NTS • Use written dimensions, not pixels or printed scale. Follow the numbered lesson.
